wealthy, or affluent gentleman!

My goal is a wedding band...
But is that really a utopia?

entries.text:
A game is life,
but life is not a game.

entries:
I am always serious. You cannot win
if you think this is just a game.

I'll give up games forever and set out
on a journey... Just kidding!

entries.text:
I'll always work part-time, because
it lets me focus on what I really love.

entries:
You have only one life to live.
Are you doing what you want to do?

I want to play here forever
without being tied down.

entries.text:
I took this job 'cause I wanted to see
smiles on people's faces.

entries:
Don't look at me like that.
Smile! Smile!

It's very frustrating,
but I am glad I saw you smile.

entries.text:
Let's start a battle already!
We are wasting time.

entries:
What? Is it already over?
We still have lots of time.

We ran out of time.
We cannot go into overtime!

entries.text:
I am battling here to promote
the café where I work.

entries:
You are not that strong,
so you are not really right for my café.

Yowza! What a strong Trainer!
See you at my café next time, OK?

entries.text:
Join the Pokéfans.
Your life will be happy!

entries:
If you join the Pokéfans,
you'll be strong like me!

If you join the Pokéfans,
your life will be saved!

entries.text:
I am not a regular Pokéfan.
I am a major mega-Pokéfan!

entries:
I love Pokémon.
I love love Pokémon!

You'll remember this!
I am a big Pokéfan!

entries.text:
I think I am a Pokéfan,
therefore I am a Pokéfan.

entries: The Pokéfan is power.

You should remember this.
I am a Pokéfan.

entries.text:
There are young and beautiful people,
but youth is different from beauty.

entries:
If I had known that when I was young,
I would not have a hard time now...

Youth is just youth.
I wish I had realized it back then.

entries.text:
Ho there! You are a mountain standing
in my way, aren't ya?

entries:
Yahoooooo!! Yahoooooooo!
Hear my cry of triumph!

Grrr... My victory has disappeared
in a crevasse...

entries.text:
Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!
I am a Hiker. I have a cult following!

entries:
Oh no? It's over already?
Hiker is bored!!

This is important, so remember this!
Don't judge a book by its cover!

entries.text:
Despite my appearance, I am the head
of a certain outfit. Don't tell anyone.

entries: Don't tell anyone that I am playing here.

The boss does not have freedom.
I feel like a captured Pokémon.

entries.text:
The truth is, I want to have a quiet life
fishing all day, every day.

entries:
Ah... I don't want to do anything but fish.
I am tired of winning and losing.

At my time of life, it doesn't matter
if I win or lose.

entries.text:
Hello? Me? What, now?
I am about to have a battle.

entries:
Hello? Can you hear me?
I just won the battle.

Ah... Hello? Can you hear me?
Argh! I lost...

entries.text:
He told me that I was like a squall,
but what is a squall?

entries:
W-wah! Wahhh!
I am so happy that I am crying.

W-w-wahhhhh! Wahhhhh!
Wahhhhh! Wahhhhh!

entries.text:
No need to chat with someone
I'm about to battle.

entries:
Life is over if you lose.
That's why I hold out.

Don't look at miserable me!
Go away!

entries.text:
You have your way.
I have my way.

entries:
I will go my way 'cause
I don't have any other way.

Your way must be rocky.
Good luck. I am behind you all the way.

entries.text:
Hey, you! Don't mess with me,
or I will destroy your Pokémon!

entries:
Thought you might make trouble for me,
but what a wimpy attack!

How could I lose to such a wimpy move?
Gah, that bugs the snot out of me!

entries.text:
My dad and mom are both Veterans,
but I am a loser...

entries:
I wonder if my mom and dad will be sad
if they see that I've become a Roughneck.

I cannot be like my mom and dad.
So I will live as a Roughneck.

entries.text:
My partner has turned to dust,
but his Pokémon is my Pokémon now.

entries:
Are you watching me, my long-lost partner?
That Pokémon of yours, we get along...

He was trash, but now he is eternal,
like the stars in the sky... Ah, my partner!

entries.text:
I am no good at speaking...
So my bike speaks...

entries:
Zooooom! Zoom whoosh!
Zooooom! Zoom zam!

Vroom! Vroom! Vroom!
Vrooooooooom! Vroom!

entries.text:
All right! Are you ready?
Don't mess with a Biker!

entries:
I'm a Biker, so I'm more obsessed
with speed than anyone else!!

The truth is we are good guys.
We cannot do bad things at all!

entries.text:
Like uncooked dough,
my Pokémon are sticky!

entries: Now you're stuck, aren't ya?
Well, your Pokémon are quite springy, too.

entries.text:
As I bake bread, I will bake your
Pokémon, too.

entries:
Oh my... Your Pokémon are like
burned bread.

Ah, how frustrating and disappointing!
You burned me with that last move...

entries.text:
Just as I knead the dough,
I'll knead you into shape.

entries:
Wanna be kneaded a little more?
Or shall I sandwich you with bread?

Ooooo! I'll remember this!
I'll turn you into a sandwich someday!

entries.text:
Laughing makes people feel better.
There seems to be scientific proof!

entries:
Haaa ha ha! Ha?
What's wrong? Let's laugh!

Laugh at miserable me--I lost against
amazing you. Laugh and you'll feel better.

entries.text:
You think you can win against me?
It might not go as smoothly as you think.

entries:
Don't underestimate me just because
I am a Harlequin.

No. This can't be happening.
You're not an ordinary person.

entries.text:
Observe my beautiful Pokémon magic!
Please watch closely!

entries:
I know a few gimmicks and tricks,
'cause this is magic.

Tricks and magic are my bread and butter.
Any Harlequin knows their worth!

entries.text:
Tedious talk is unnecessary...
I will just break you...

entries: What? Are you broken already?
Ugh, I'm broken...

entries.text:
I have low self-esteem,
so I like someone to give me orders.

entries:
You are not my boss, so
it doesn't matter even if you are weak.
Can I call you my boss?

entries.text:
This outfit is not a uniform,
it's what I like to wear. I made it myself.

entries:
This is a uniform from an anime.
Doesn't it look good on me?

I want to live in a world of games,
anime, and comics forever.

entries.text:
I'm not cut out for a regular job,
so I live on art.

entries:
I envy Pokémon, 'cause they are
carefree. I want to be a Pokémon.

Bah, if I can do a regular job,
I will quit doing this stinking art.

entries.text:
Every time a Pokémon uses a move,
my heart will tremble!

entries:
Nothing stirs the soul
more than Pokémon moves.

Aha! Pokémon moves are so beautiful!
I could almost faint!

entries.text:
I will make you cry,
'cause you just don't know when to quit.

entries:
A state of deep sorrow and confusion
can also be art.

Someday, you will appreciate the value
of defeat and sorrow.

entries.text:
Our job is hard,
'cause it's such physical work.

entries: My work gave me these great muscles.

Don't underestimate the power of kids.
Like I did with you!

entries.text:
Raising Pokémon and raising kids.
Both are very hard.

entries:
When my Pokémon do well like this,
I forget my everyday troubles.

Even I raise them with tender care,
because I am their Trainer...

entries.text:
Hey, you!
I promise I will take it easy on you!

entries: Heheh... I will take it easy on you. Heh.

Sometimes even grown-ups want
someone to take care of them.

entries.text:
The job site is quite dangerous, but
I'll have to keep working with Pokémon.

entries:
I have trained my Pokémon well,
and it's ready to go to the job site.

Ugh. I cannot make money tomorrow
'cause I am injured.

entries.text: Welcome!

entries:
Only the winner!
Only the winner can celebrate.
Enough... That's enough...

entries.text:
I do menial work every single day.
Am I just a cog in the machine?

entries:
I am well broken in. No snags slow down
the smooth running of this machine!

I may be happier than a person who
cannot even be a cog in the machine.

entries.text:
Yo, kid! Are you new? I'm the Worker
that everybody is talking about.

entries:
If you don't know me, you're bogus!
Good-bye! The Worker is heading out.

Kid! Remember me! I am the Worker
everybody's talking about.

entries.text:
Well, let me introduce myself.
These are my little darlings.

entries:
How was it? My little darlings are tough and
cute, aren't they?
Phew! Your little darlings are awesome, too!

entries.text: Whir, whir, whir, whoooosh!

entries: Ring-ring! Ding-ding!
Bam!

entries.text:
This is the very latest model,
a limited-edition, carbon-fiber Bicycle.

entries:
When you have good tools,
you feel better about yourself.

Don't! Please don't touch my Bicycle.
You'll cover it with your filthy fingerprints.

entries.text:
Speed is the key in a battle!
Dash! Dash! Dash!

entries:
If I compare how I'm feeling right now to a
race, it is just like crossing the finish line!

I cannot take your nonsense anymore!
I am moving back to my mother's place.

entries.text:
Hey, you! Take out all the Pokémon
you have here!

entries:
Huh? That's all you have?
Aren't you hiding a few more Pokémon?

I see. There seems to be nothing
suspicious about you or your Pokémon.

entries.text: I'll protect my peace by myself.

entries: My peace remains protected.
Please don't disturb my peace and quiet.

entries.text:
I was born to work.
That is my destiny.

entries:
I will work, work, and work some more.
I am happy only when I am working.

As a matter of fact, having battles
is my job, too.

entries.text:
I'm-a lowest rank now, but
I'm-a gonna be at the top someday!

entries:
I'm-a gonna be the brightest star
in the business! Top of the world, ma!

You work it like a shining star!
I'm not gonna lose, I'm not gonna lose!

entries.text:
I have an ambition!
I will take over the company!

entries:
All this serves my ambition!
It brings my sweet victory one step closer!

I was obsessed with the golden prize,
with my glittering ambition!

entries.text:
I am treated as an idol at the office.
Everybody pampers me.

entries:
Everybody works for me,
so I have nothing to do.

The truth is I don't like brushing my teeth
or taking a bath, but don't tell anyone.

entries.text:
You look dusty.
I'll give you a good scrub!

entries: OK, you look a little bit cleaner now!

Hey! Don't run away!
You need to be scrubbed more!

entries.text:
These fruits of stubbornness were raised
stubbornly by a stubborn old man.

entries:
This stubborn old man raised them.
My persistence is different from yours!

There's a fine line between persistence
and stubbornness. I may retire soon.

entries.text:
I'm good at driving, but
I'm not good at dealing with Pokémon.

entries:
Oh, it went unexpectedly well.
By any chance, am I a technician?

My train does what I need. It's harder to
convince living Pokémon to do things my way.

entries.text:
I've never left this place even once
since I was born.

entries:
I wonder if I will live here
for the rest of my life...

I wonder how long I will stay here...
What is there outside this world?

entries.text:
I say this as a Doctor.
First of all, you must save money.

entries:
Money cannot buy health.
But you cannot stay healthy if you're poor.

Because without money, you can neither
eat healthy food nor go to see a Doctor.

entries.text:
As you can see, I am a Doctor,
but I've never examined a patient.

entries:
I've studied to become a Doctor,
but I faint when I see blood.

I am a Sunday Doctor,
rather like a Sunday driver.

entries.text:
Can you understand
what medical personnel need?

entries:
What a Doctor needs is love--
the rush of unconditional love.

Medical service is love.
Can you be a Doctor?

entries.text:
I took this job because I wanted
to be needed by someone.

entries:
My job is hard,
but I am happy to help people.

When a patient leaves the hospital,
I feel happy but a bit sad.

entries.text:
Grown-ups have a lot of hobbies.
Actually, I am a uniform collector.

entries:
I am not a Nurse.
I wear this uniform just for fun.

You realized that I am a fake Nurse!
Yes, I am just a uniform collector.

entries.text:
Even if you are injured, I will treat you.
So let's fight hard.

entries:
Sorry! I went too far. Do you require
immediate hospitalization?

You went too far! I will bill you
the cost of my medical expenses!

entries.text:
I raised these very special Pokémon
using a special method.

entries:
Pokémon will be strong or weak
depending on how you raise them.

Ugh... It wasn't supposed to be like this.
Did I blend the essence wrong?

entries.text:
Shall I share an exclusive tip
for training great Pokémon?

entries:
You'll be perfect if you buy my book
of Pokémon training tips.

You'll be fine if you buy my DVD
of Pokémon training tips.

entries.text:
Pokémon are my family!
See the solidarity of my family!

entries:
Well done, brothers and sisters!
Our family solidarity is invincible!

NO! My family!
What have you done?!

entries.text:
What you like and what you're good at
are different, or at least separate.

entries:
I am good at battling,
but I don't enjoy it very much.

If you like what you do as a job,
you have a sense of fulfillment, don't you?

entries.text: In summary, you cannot win against me.

entries:
You see, you cannot win, because
you are very weak.

Hummmm... You are good.
You are really pretty good.

entries.text:
Don't underestimate me because I'm old.
I'll show you my rejuvenating attack!

entries:
I'm old but still going strong!
I can take care of myself!

What a cruel way to treat a helpless
old man! Shame on you!

entries.text:
I would like to retire soon. But I have
no one to carry on the family tradition...

entries:
If I had a child like you,
my golden years would be carefree...

I wish my son were
as mature as you are.

entries.text:
I feel sad when I see a young and
bright child like you.

entries:
The first flush of youth...
You are too bright for me...

Sparkling eyes, firm skin...
I won't get them back.

entries.text:
Hey! It's me. It's me!
I am the best Pilot in the world!

entries: How's that? Pwned!!

You! Who are you?!
Do you know who I am?

entries.text:
I'm at the top of the heap! I'm a man
who always wants to come in first.

entries:
Remember this! My favorite words
are "top of the heap."

You. Well done!
See you! I'll remember this!

entries.text:
I won't back down, lose, or fail!
No defeat for a Clerk ⑭.

entries: Uh-huh!

Uuugh... Well done...
You made me fall to my knees...

entries.text:
I can do it! I can do anything!
I will do it! I will do it!

entries:
Yes! I did it! I can do it!
I can do it! I can doooooooo it!

But I listened to my Teacher's advice.
I can't lose! I can't!

entries.text:
My research will lead this world
to peace and happiness.

entries:
I am a genius. I will control
the future of the world!

I am a genius... I am not supposed
to lose against someone like you...

entries.text:
Only research is left in my life.
I abandoned my family and friends.

entries:
It's not bad to devote my whole life
to research, is it?

Dedicating yourself to something
can cause loneliness.

entries.text:
Hyuck-yuck-yuck... Please lend me
a hand for my experiment.

entries:
Hyuck-yuck-yuck... I did it.
The experiment was a huge success.

Ho-hum. This is not good...
This experiment was a failure...

entries.text:
You must face off against
my extremely powered-up Pokémon!

entries:
Well, this is a natural outcome.
The power of science is awesome.

Your Pokémon have even more awesome
strength than the power of science.

entries.text:
If you lose, I'll have you help me
in my latest experiment!

entries:
Ho hi ho. You lost! You will help science
as my new assistant.

Pah. I was sooo close to signing you up
as my new assistant.

entries.text:
Why do people compete and fight?
This is the subject of my research.

entries:
Even if you win, you will hurt your
opponent's feelings.
If you lose, you may resent your opponent.

entries.text: Hi! Focus!

entries: Foooooooooooo!
Eeek!

entries.text:
Speech can be utter nonsense.
Pretty words only taint battles...

entries:
Trainers who treat battles as a sport
are the height of vileness...

Defeat is worth nothing.
Losers don't need words...

entries.text:
He-he-he. If you lose,
I will turn you into a Pokémon.

entries:
He-he-he. Well, from today on,
you are already a Pokémon.

Next time I see you, I will turn you
into a Pokémon with my power.

entries.text:
Argh... I have a headache...
I have such a headache...

entries:
I don't need psychic powers.
Please stop this headache...

If I don't keep using my power for battles,
my headache won't go away...

entries.text:
I claim that I am a Psychic,
but I cannot use psychic powers.

entries:
I am camouflaging it
with my Psychic-ish costume.

I go to magic classes
to look like a Psychic.

entries.text:
...Grrr... Yeeek!!
An evil spirit! Go away!!

entries:
OK! The evil spirit
that possessed you has disappeared.

Evil spirit!
Leave the Trainer at once!

entries.text:
I praise your courage for challenging me!
I am the one with the strongest kick.

entries:
Haha... I probably did not have to use
my strongest kick on you.

Oh... The Pokémon did the fighting.
My strong kick didn't help a bit.

entries.text:
'Suuup! I'll give it all I've got!
Let's do our best!!

entries:
'Sup! That's enough!
Please value your life!

'Suuuuup! Good work. I tried everything
I could, but I'm disappointed.

entries.text: Yo!

entries: Yo! Yo! Yo!
Yo!

entries.text:
You don't have to impress me.
You can lose against me.

entries: Come. Sleep quietly in my arms...

It's sad to say good-bye,
but we're running out of time.

entries.text:
Are you ready?
I'll take the gloves off.

entries:
Well, well... You're not even in my league.
This is like bullying.

Aww... I cannot believe I lost!
Who are you?!

entries.text:
I would like to do the fighting
instead of my Pokémon if I could.

entries:
Pokémon battles are not enough of a
challenge. I want to make this personal.

Ah, I tingle with excitement.
I would like to fight...

entries.text:
Halt at once! You over there!
Let us cross lances!

entries: Trainer, you are at my mercy!

Trainer, I yield! 
Please spare me. Please!

entries.text:
When I am surrounded by nature,
most other things cease to matter.

entries:
I won. But victory is nothing,
compared to the vastness of nature...

It doesn't matter to the vastness
of nature whether I win or lose...

entries.text:
Despite my appearance, I am a city boy.
So I yearn for country life.

entries:
Do you have a hometown?
If so, you should go back and visit there.

I don't have a hometown to go back to,
'cause I was born and raised in the city.

entries.text:
It's my mission to protect nature
and all Pokémon living there!

entries:
If villains disturb the natural order,
I will put them all in jail!

Protect Mother Nature!
Otherwise, I will put you in jail!

entries.text:
We need a lot of money to protect
Mother Nature and her Pokémon.

entries:
Please donate money for a rich natural
environment and for the Pokémon.

We protect forests and Pokémon by
saving money and planting trees.

entries.text: Let me stop your winning streak here.

entries:
Ah. You still have much to learn.
Let me give you a crash course!

You didn't win alone. You couldn't have won
without your Pokémon.

entries.text:
You seem to be quite confident.
I'll sink you straight away.

entries:
I am devoting my body and soul
to Pokémon battles!

AAAAAAAAH! I am sooooo scared!
I will never do it again... Sorrrry!

entries.text:
I'm working very hard, but
that doesn't mean I am strong.

entries:
You're a strong Trainer,
so I think I was just lucky this time.

Even I can lose?!
But I'm a battling genius!

entries.text:
I started battling just to be cool, but
I became an Ace before I knew it.

entries:
People can become strong if they have
clear goals. That's the way it goes.

I'm still not popular even though
I've been recognized as an Ace.

entries.text:
The lead character of this story...
I'll tell you who it is!

entries:
The lead character of the story is me!
You are just an extra!
Of course, you are the lead character!

entries.text:
We would like to hold a Pokémon battle
against the strongest foe.

entries:
We cannot believe we spent time
on such a childish battle! Leave at once!

Ho-ho-ho! That is to our liking!
We find ourselves quite satisfied!

entries.text:
A person who wants to fight, fight, and
fight forever. That's the way of the Ace.

entries:
However hard they battle, they won't be
satisfied. That is a real Trainer, isn't it?

Your fighting style suits you very well.
You can be an Ace Trainer.

entries.text:
I can see despair in your eyes.
Bring it on!

entries:
It was a waste of time, much as I suspected.
You should start training all over again.

Did I underestimate you as just a little kid?
Or was this your true ability?

entries.text:
Hey, you, young Trainer.
I am utterly stylish, aren't I?

entries:
I am so stylish,
I hypnotize myself! Step back!

I'm a wreck. I'm adrift. It just kills me.
It is hard to be too stylish.

entries.text:
I won't lose against a kid like you,
who doesn't know anything about battles.

entries:
After all, you are an amateur. No sweat.
(Whew... That was a little too close!)

What? This kid is a fast learner?
Ha ha ha... I had no idea!

entries.text:
Argh. Cough, cough. I don't feel well.
Please show a little kindness.

entries:
I lied when I said I didn't feel well!
Veterans do anything to win!

You're very sharp!
You did not fall for my illness act.

entries.text:
I will give you a taste
of a Veteran's well-trained Pokémon.

entries:
How were the Veteran's Pokémon?
Defeat is bitter, isn't it?

You have served me a spicy defeat.
And yet defeat is also part of life.

entries.text:
Oh, you are so cute!
Come, I promise to be nice in this battle.

entries:
You are so cute, really...
I want to see you again. I'll be waiting.

Your battle is a little too cute.
Let's play again sometime.

entries.text:
Oh, you are still a child.
Who said you could come here?

entries:
You're not bad, but you're immature.
Come back when you've learned something.

I thought you were a child.
Hee hee... You are tough...

entries.text:
Don't call me a Veteran!
A woman's mind is always blooming.

entries:
I'm not finished with love or Pokémon.
I'll stay fit and ready all my life.

I have pains in my eyes, my shoulder, and
my back, but my heart is forever young.

entries.text:
I am the strongest Backpacker.
I have a lot of Pokémon in my Bag.

entries:
Hahaha! I am as big as my backpack,
aren't I? Aren't I?

I have more Pokémon in my Bag!
Wait, my Bag has a hole...

entries.text: I am not traveling for freedom.

entries:
You're carrying bulky luggage,
but do you really need it?

My Bag is as wide as the sky.
In other words, my Bag is empty.

entries.text:
I haven't eaten anything for days.
Spots are floating before my eyes...

entries:
Those aren't spots floating before my eyes.
Those are glorious glimmers of victory!

Ah, I'm sinking fast. All I can think about
is where my next meal is coming from...

entries.text:
Neither my husband nor I have money,
so we are hitchhiking on our honeymoon.

entries:
Newly married, and such a big trip...
I'm worried about our future.

On top of that, I have lost track of him...
Where can he be wandering?

entries.text:
Hey! Hey! 
Please check out my cute Pokémon!

entries:
How about that?
I'm proud of these Pokémon.

Oh no, don't bother them like that!
Please leave my Pokémon alone.

entries.text:
Being a Waiter is my disguise,
and it helps me live quietly.

entries:
On my days off, the real me is ready.
I'm an Ace Trainer!

I'm struggling to make a living,
so I've been in disguise a long time.

entries.text:
My Pokémon are the strongest.
I don't think I will lose.

entries:
Do you think you can win against me
with such wimpy Pokémon?

Ah... It's hard.
It sure is frustrating to lose.

entries.text:
Don't you think a restaurant
for Pokémon is a fun idea?

entries:
I wonder if people will like
a full-course meal for Pokémon.

It's a restaurant for Pokémon,
not a restaurant of Pokémon!

entries.text: Harrumph! Haroooo!

entries: Harooo!
Harrumph!!

entries.text:
I am the mountain range of your life!
Cross me if you can!

entries:
Haha! I am the summit, and the road
to reach me is still very steep!

Finally, someone has climbed the mountain!
This is my summit!

entries.text:
If I lose, I'll spill the secret of fishing.
If I win, I'll tell you the essence.

entries:
The essence of fishing is to pull
and reel in the fish--nothing else.

The secret of fishing is to wait without
thinking, as if you were dozing off.

entries.text:
I always aim for a big fish!
Stay out of this if you are a small fish!

entries:
Reeling you in was hard work.
You put up a good fight!

Oh! What a great hit!
Both my arms and heart are electrified!

entries.text:
You look kind of mature.
I like people like you.

entries:
Still, you look mature for your age.
Are you already an adult, or are you a kid?

A man with the heart of a boy
is just a wheedling child.

entries.text:
How much did this parasol cost?
Why, it is a cheap disposable.

entries:
I am a Parasol Lady, but I cannot
spend money for a parasol.

A parasol is just a tool. It’s fine
as long as it protects me from the rain.

entries.text:
I can really cut loose in Pokémon
battles without being scolded.

entries:
Nobody scolds me. That's why
Pokémon battles are the best!

You like a big fight, don't ya?
You are my pal.

entries.text:
My computer friends said I wouldn't be
taken lightly with this look.

entries:
I won, but I was so scared...
Maybe I am not cut out for this.

Eeek... I should have played
with my computer in my room.

entries.text:
My ride and I
are always together.

entries: My ride helps me show off who I am.

My motorbike makes me feel better
when I lose.

entries.text:
I don't have money to buy gas,
so I have to push it with my feet.

entries:
I'm one of the Bikers,
so my bike is crucial.

Ah... Dad, Mom.
It's hard to be a Biker...

entries.text:
Aah, I am so hungry that I am
completely wiped out. What shall I do?

entries:
I'm working at a bakery, 'cause I want to
eat bread anytime I want.

Aah! I crashed from my sugar high!
Someone give me a pastry!

entries.text:
OK, I will do it! 
I am excited about this!

entries: Blast!
I'll remember this!

entries.text:
I'll confuse you with my smooth moves.
A-one, a-two, cha cha cha!

entries:
You could not focus on the battle,
'cause you were watching my smooth steps!

And one, and two, and twirl, and...
Ah, that didn't work at all!

entries.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Your idol, Harlequin, Harlequin.

entries:
Thank you very much.
It was Harlequin, Harlequin.

It was Harlequin, Harlequin.
Thank you for your support.

entries.text: If you lose, you can be my servant.

entries: From now on, I am your employer.
I'll make you my servant someday.

entries.text:
Ahhhh... So strange.
I feel very, very tired.

entries:
I still feel kind of blah.
I'm all achy...

I really feel blah.
Well, I will go home now.

entries.text:
A child like you cannot understand
the beauty that I am pursuing.

entries:
I am a servant of beauty.
Ugly defeat does not suit me.

Perhaps the beauty I've been looking for...
is you?

entries.text:
I paint pictures and live with Pokémon.
I am enjoying my life!

entries:
The sting of defeat will be a good
memory as you grow older.

Experience hardships when you are young,
'cause old bodies cannot take them.

entries.text:
My schoolkids are sleeping.
I'm shooting for the top during nap time!

entries:
Oh, no!
Look at the time!

After nap time comes snack time.
I have to go back to preschool soon.

entries.text:
Life is full of so many farewells,
so I will enjoy the present.

entries:
I cannot see you again,
so I will do my best.

This is a woman's life.
Can a baby like you understand it?

entries.text:
If you work diligently,
you will get results.

entries:
You, keep trying.
Master the basics.

Well, even if you work diligently,
things don't always go well.

entries.text:
I've arrived from a distant island.
May I please trouble you for a battle?

entries: I have won.

I was utterly inexperienced. I'd be 
grateful if I could be your pupil.

entries.text:
I am so obsessed with Pokémon
that my wife is as mad as a hornet.

entries:
Pokémon battles are so much fun.
No way I can quit.

I don't want to go home, 'cause my wife
is as scary as a legendary Pokémon.

entries.text:
Our lives have plenty of ordinary days.
I gotta have Pokémon!

entries:
Only Pokémon rescue me
from boring and monotonous days.

When I look at a special person like you,
I just melt.

entries.text:
I used to be like you.
I was full of hopes and dreams.

entries:
Dreams are important.
But if all you have is your dreamworld...

Just having hopes and dreams is not enough.
What is important is... Never mind.

entries.text:
I want to have an exhilarating battle.
Got it?

entries:
Thank you!
A battle is extremely exhilarating!

OK, OK, I got it...
Let's call it a day.

entries.text:
It's OK if I have training wheels.
It’s OK if my Bike doesn't accelerate.

entries:
It's OK if you go your own way.
You'll reach your goal someday.

It's OK if you lose.
It's OK, 'cause you have a Bicycle.

entries.text:
You ain't never even gonna see
my Pokémon's moves.

entries: You're slow, ain't ya?

You're right quick! 
Who are ya, anyways?

entries.text:
I just got married, and we'll be
expanding our family soon.

entries:
You know what I need.
Can you spare a few dollars?

Oh, I should really get home,
but Pokémon battles are so much fun...

entries.text:
Take a good look
at this Clerk ⑭'s sheer strength!

entries:
You got me!
You have the best skills in the world!

I put on a smile when I'm crying inside.
That's a Clerk ⑭'s sad smile.

entries.text:
I will show you the harsh side
of Pokémon battles.

entries:
That's not good.
I was too generous today.

Did you burn the image of my Pokémon
into your mind?

entries.text:
Who do you think I am?
I am a mighty Policeman!

entries:
That's for disobeying me!
I am a big guy!

You won a battle against a Policeman...
I will arrest you someday.

entries.text:
It's embarrassing, but I wasn't
well behaved when I was young.

entries:
You lack energy despite your youth.
Shall I train you?

Good, good. Misbehave while you're still
young and you can get away with it.

entries.text:
Squeak! Squeak, squeak, squeak...
Hm? What? Wanna fight?

entries:
You're so impatient.
I'm still in the middle of my work.

Ohh dear... You tracked dirt
on the floor I just finished cleaning...

entries.text:
There are only two roads in life.
The one you like, and the one you hate.

entries:
I'll choose the road I like,
even though it is not the quickest route.

Actually, the road you hate
may be the shortcut to your goal.

entries.text:
I am a train.
I will just run on the tracks.

entries:
You are a station where I don't stop.
I will just pass you by.

I think the train is great, because it runs
the same route over and over.

entries.text:
You're good at your job
and very strong.

entries:
I expected too much from you.
You are lucky that this is not business.

A person who can juggle
work and play is pretty cool.

entries.text:
I've been with these Pokémon
since I was a child.

entries: Pokémon are like family to me.

I don't think I want to have children.
I'd rather focus on my Pokémon family.

entries.text:
Hi, I am a physician!
Hey! Let me give you a shot!

entries:
Come now, let me give you a shot!
Don’t worry. It won't hurt!

You have strong arms!
So let me give you a shot now!

entries.text:
Cough! Cough, cough! How many
more people will I be able to save?

entries:
Cough! I wanted to save more people.
Cough, cough!

Few physicians live well...
Cough! I can't go on any longer...

entries.text:
Do you want a shot?
Or an IV drip?

entries:
You want both a shot and an IV.
You are greedy!

Argh. It's sickening!
You're such a drip.

entries.text:
In this job,
I've seen a lot of strange things.

entries:
I don't know why, but Ghost-type 
Pokémon seem attracted to me.

Ahhh, I lost... By the way,
who is that standing behind you?

entries.text:
I have raised them too long.
They are beyond my control...

entries:
It's over...
Nobody can stop them...

Finally, they calmed down...
You saved me. Thank you!

entries.text:
I will test the Pokémon
you have been training.

entries:
Bah! Is that the best you can do?
I expected more from you...

Wow! You are awesome!
What great Pokémon you've trained!

entries.text:
Take a look at these Pokémon--I raised
'em myself. They make me right proud.

entries:
I am right proud of these Pokémon.
They're my friends and my treasures.

You are a strong one, sure enuff.
But I don't intend to lose next time!

entries.text:
I am the top Breeder.
I can tame any kind of Pokémon.

entries:
You see? My Pokémon are very loyal, 
aren't they?

They are too attached to me.
They are not fit for battling.

entries.text:
Arghhhh! Who is gentle?!
I will bring you down!

entries:
Arghh! Arghh! 
I am NOT a Gentleman!

Arghh! You! You'll regret this!
I will bring you down someday!

entries.text:
My brother told me once...
Eyes! Aim for the eyes!

entries:
What my brother told me was right...
Thanks... Bro...

I lost against a kid. Bro...
I should have listened to you...

entries.text:
I can't drop my luxurious lifestyle just
because I'm older. Nothing can stop it.

entries:
It may be a hard truth for a child,
but money makes the world go round.

I cannot drop the habits
I learned when I was young.

entries.text:
I am a late bloomer and a crazy bloomer.
I'll bloom and dazzle you!

entries:
Dance, bloom, and blossom!
A woman who flowers and triumphs!

I want to blossom and fall
rather than dying on the vine.

entries.text:
Hey, it's me. It's me!
I am the best Pilot in the world!

entries:
No! That's no good!
You cannot reach the top that way.

Good. You're daring!
I'll let you come fly on my plane.

entries.text:
Hey! Yo! It's me.
I am the best Pilot in the world.

entries:
Listen! A Trainer should be No. 1.
That's it!

You're quite a Trainer!
Be my apprentice!
